column1: # Seeded deviations. Each is an exact-text edit (`\n` for newlines). Expected:
#   <proof file>:<theorem>[,<theorem>]  rejected, with every error inside those theorems
#   accepted                            still proves every theorem with the same statement

column3: match k.inbox c with\n  | [] => none\n  | input :: rest =>
column4: match (k.inbox c).reverse with\n  | [] => none\n  | input :: rest =>

column3: pushAll ⟨k.state, update k.inbox d (k.inbox d ++ [i])⟩ ms
column4: pushAll ⟨k.state, update k.inbox d (i :: k.inbox d)⟩ ms

column3: | some o => some (pushAll N k1 (N.route c o))
let k1 : Config N := ⟨update k.state c state, update k.inbox c rest⟩
column4: let k1 : Config N := ⟨k.state, update k.inbox c rest⟩

column3: (serve N s.cfg c).map fun k => ⟨k, (c.val + 1) % N.size⟩
column4: (serve N s.cfg c).map fun k => ⟨k, c.val⟩
